items.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: Earl Hines ... was at the top of the list [of piano players for me to listen to and buy records]

ctx.x: Yeah. Did he get into any kind of piano styles? Showed you the options?

Oh yes. Well I think his favorite — judging from the way he played — was Art Tatum. Because he played a lot of notes. And he wrote out a list of piano players for me to listen to and buy records. And Art Tatum was at the top of the list, Nat King Cole, Earl Hines, Fats Waller, Count Basie — no I don’t think Count Basie was on the list but I became attached to Count Basie anyhow.
